findings: Two real 512 MiB QEMU TCG guests reached Linux and cloud-init and fetched their owned, restricted NoCloud configuration.
The resource guard stopped the attempt at 15041576960 cgroup bytes, above the 14 GiB ceiling; the cgroup OOM-kill counter did not increase.
The controller stopped and waited for both exact owned QEMU process identities, then verified that no owned QEMU process, bridge or listening port remained.
The guests did not produce the required guest HTTP readiness, 30-second overlap or distinct salted boot and machine identity witnesses.
limitations: This is one physical host and cannot establish physical-machine or availability-zone independence.
It did not run Prefect native workers, portable package transfer, replacement or recovery.
Boot success and exact cleanup do not satisfy ADR-0047 A47-04 or NI2-053.
retry: No retry is authorized from this observation; a later attempt requires a new resource premise and its own bounded admission.
